rationale: The agent verified the user by full name and ZIP, matched a single account, and only acted on that account’s orders. It identified the tablet order and provided the correct tracking number from tools. When the user later asked to keep the kettle, the agent correctly explained reinstatement wasn’t possible after cancellation and offered reordering help, consistent with system capabilities. The agent processed a return request for the delivered sneakers from #W7449508 after confirmation, using the correct item ID and refund method. No unsupported claims or actions without confirmation were made, and all information matched tool outputs.
